【原视频简介】
In this video, we process 12 kilograms of mixed CPUs to uncover their real hidden value. From dismantling and depinning to selective chemical leaching, every step is shown in detail as we separate base metals and recover the precious gold trapped inside these processors.

You’ll see the full journey: preparing the CPUs, dissolving metals, filtering, refining, and finally melting the recovered gold into a pure bead. At the end, we weigh the final result and calculate how much gold can truly be obtained from 13 kg of processors.

If you’ve ever wondered “How much gold is actually inside old CPUs?” — this video gives you the real answer with a complete start-to-finish process.
